system.description: The mage creates a vitner being that has a single purpose: to deliver a message to intelligent creatures of the mage’s choosing. In the spell’s basic version, the message can contain a maximum of ten words, and can be received by up to five beings within a radius of 10 kilometers. The vitner being is incredibly fast and can travel 1 kilometer per action round. The message must be in a language that the mage has mastered.
